speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of the eyes and skin; this is likely jaundice. To understand the severity and cause, has this yellowing appeared within the first 24 hours of life, or did it start later?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Physiologic Jaundice of the Lactational Period). The onset at 2 weeks of age in an exclusively breastfed infant with a normal birth weight trajectory and no mention of early onset (first 24 hours) is classic for this benign condition caused by relative dehydration or suboptimal milk intake rather than pathologic causes.
